# Home

This wiki has two parts.
One part is about `claudetto`, a plugin marketplace for Claude Code.
The other part is a reference of how Claude Code `2.1.303` works.
You can read each part alone.

## `claudetto` 0.2.0+

`claudetto` is a plugin marketplace for software engineering with Claude Code.
It changes Claude Code with the Mod API, settings, hooks, skills, agents, and output styles.
It does not patch the program.
Its goal is the best quality for the lowest token cost.
`claudetto` needs Claude Code `2.1.303` or later.

For example, the `Guard` slice denies a risky command before Claude Code runs it.

### Slices

The core plugin has 15 slices, and each slice has one page:
[Advise](Advise), [Decide](Decide), [Dry](Dry), [Goal](Goal), [Ground](Ground), [Guard](Guard), [Handoff](Handoff), [Patch](Patch), [Prompt](Prompt), [Reply](Reply), [Sembr](Sembr), [Setup](Setup), [Spec](Spec), [Status Line](Status-Line), and [Styles](Styles).

### Add-Ons

Each add-on is a separate plugin, and it works without the core plugin.

| Plugin | What it does | Page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claudetto-codegraph` | Gives Claude the code graph of a project. | [Code Graph](Code-Graph) |
| `claudetto-browser` | Drives a browser, and answers `WebSearch` with a headless search. | [Browser](Browser) |
| `claudetto-docs` | Gets current docs of libraries and APIs. | [Library Docs](Library-Docs) |
| `claudetto-sessions` | Audits the setup and replays a hook on past transcripts. | [Sessions](Sessions) |
| `claudetto-lab` | Gives tools for plugin authors. | [Lab](Lab) |

The marketplace is on [Add-Ons](Add-Ons).

## How Claude Code 2.1.303 Works

This part is a reference of Claude Code `2.1.303`, the newest release on 2026-10-19.
It tells how a turn runs, which settings, hooks, tools, and env vars exist, and how to change each one.
It also lists the items that the official docs do not name.
Each fact names its source: a docs page, or the program itself.

For example, [Claude Code Hooks](Claude-Code-Hooks) lists each hook event with its input and its output.

### Marks

Each row in a table has one mark.

| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ | A page of the [official docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en) names the item. |
| 🔍 | No docs page names the item, and it is found only in the program. |
| ⚠️ | The docs and the program differ. |
| 🧪 | The item works only behind a flag or a gate. |
| ❌ | The item is removed or does nothing in `2.1.303`. |

A yes or no value in a table is ✅ or ❌.
